Name: Wilderness of Zin
ModernLocation: Desert south of Canaan around Kadesh, modern Negev
Description: The desert wilderness bordering Edom where Israel camped at Kadesh, and from which the spies entered the land.
BiblicalSignificance: Zin is the wilderness of Kadesh: Miriam died here, Moses struck the rock here, and the spies set out from here.
